To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the utilization of customer specific knowledge in key account management is enhanced by the use of teams and by top management involvement in the key account process.

the utilization of customer specific knowledge in the management and control of key account relationships is positively influenced by KAM formalization, the use of teams in the management of KAM, the use of CRM technology and the involvement of top management in KAM.
customer knowledge utilization can be enhanced by the use of teams and top management involvement in key account management.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to enhance the use of customer knowledge in key account management.
the question, which intra-organizational antecedents enhance the utilization of knowledge in key account management.
the utilization of customer specific knowledge in the management and development of key accounts and provides a first step in understanding the organizational factors that influence this process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the more a company uses the four investigated intra-organizational elements, the better it is able to utilize the customer-specific knowledge in the management and development of its key account relationships.

customer knowledge utilization is enhanced when a firm uses teams, top management is actively involved in the KAM process, the KAM process is formally organized and the organization uses CRM technology.

the utilization of customer specific knowledge in the management and handling of key accounts is enhanced by the use of teams and top management involvement, formalization of KAM and the application of CRM technology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of a team approach, a high level of top management involvement, formalization of KAM activities and CRM technology enhance customer knowledge utilization in key account relationships.
the use of customer knowledge is a key factor in the success of key account management.
the more the organization utilizes customer knowledge, the more it will benefit from it.
The main takeaway from our work is that
companies can enhance customer knowledge utilization in KAM relationships by implementing a number of organizational practices that can be implemented at low cost.
the utilization of customer specific knowledge in the management and maintenance of key customer relationships requires the support of the organization and the use of specific tools and technologies.
customer knowledge utilization is not only a matter of the customer, but also an organizational issue that requires a certain degree of internal organizational effort.
